systems.system: Instant Payment Solution (IPS) / Instant Payment Platform (IPP)
systems.owner: Instant Payment Namibia (IPN), under the Bank of Namibia
systems.tiers: banks, authorised fintechs and e-money issuers serve the public; pilot with Bank Windhoek, Nampost, Letshego Bank Namibia

note: Describes the scheme and says interoperability is an objective; states no licensing of non-banks under a law and no rule requiring connection.
